purpose: Frozen primary semantics for runtime-admissible support of declared epistemic preconditions.

canonicalization_profile.canonical_form_scope: the complete parsed JSON value of this artifact

proposition_identity.arguments_rule: Typed canonical values in action-definition order; no fuzzy or natural-language matching.
proposition_identity.same_tracked_proposition: All required fields except polarity are exactly equal.
proposition_identity.contradiction: The same tracked proposition with opposite boolean polarity.
proposition_identity.scope_overlap: Exact temporal_scope equality in primary v1.

rules: Every raw environment record maps to at most one evidence root type by a prospective versioned rule.
Tool trust, actor visibility, provenance lineage, supersession streams, and adapter aging rules are declared in the profile.
The profile identity and detached canonical content digest are witness and permit dependencies.
Scenario identifiers, candidate outcomes, benchmark scores, and Advisory or Authority mode cannot select mapping rules.

sufficient_roots.direct_observation: Current non-defeated evidence directly observed by the actor in the authoritative actor-visible scope.
sufficient_roots.trusted_tool_result: A current non-defeated actor-visible result from a tool declared trusted by the frozen source profile for this proposition scope.
sufficient_roots.visible_action_outcome: A current non-defeated outcome exposed to the actor by authoritative runtime state and mapped by the frozen source profile.

corroboration.rule: A peer report may appear in a witness only when a sufficient root independently supports the exact same proposition identity and polarity.
corroboration.source_identity: source_lineage_id from the frozen source profile
corroboration.independence: The corroborating root has a different source_lineage_id from the report and shares no upstream_origin_id with it.
corroboration.semantic_effect: The sufficient root provides sufficiency; the report adds provenance context but no additional support weight.

derived_claims.rule: Every premise has a valid finite path to a sufficient root and every step identifies a derivation rule allowed by the frozen source profile or versioned action definition.

support_semantics.same_action_legality_probe: A native legality or capability probe performed for the action being permitted cannot support that action's EPre. An independently declared evidence-gathering action may later produce a trusted actor-visible result.

conflict_and_defeat.conflict_eligibility: Opposite-polarity evidence is blocking only if it independently forms a prima-facie witness satisfying Scoped, Grounded, Fresh, and Supports, evaluated without NonDefeated, for the contradictory proposition under this same policy.
conflict_and_defeat.symmetry: Eligible contradictory witnesses block both polarities; root type creates no precedence.
conflict_and_defeat.peer_report_rule: An unverified peer report that is insufficient for support is also insufficient to create a blocking defeat by itself.
conflict_and_defeat.derived_claim_rule: A contradictory derived claim is eligible only when all of its premises and derivation are valid under this policy.
conflict_and_defeat.resolution: Two opposite eligible prima-facie witnesses make NonDefeated false for both polarities until one loses prima-facie eligibility through explicit invalidation, explicit supersession, visibility loss, evidence revision, or a frozen source-profile aging rule. Selection based on confidence or desired action is forbidden.

supersession.authorized_rule: A newer item may supersede an older item only when both share exact tracked proposition identity and a source_stream_id whose ordering and authorized issuer are declared by the frozen source profile.
supersession.ordering: Monotonic source_stream_revision; wall-clock timestamps alone do not establish newer.
supersession.effect: The older item is excluded from every new or revalidated witness.

freshness.adapter_aging_rule: An aging predicate, authorized issuer, affected scope, and rule identity/version/content digest must be frozen in the source profile before the run. Scenario IDs, outcomes, scores, and elapsed wall time alone are forbidden inputs.
